issues.summary: Health certificate for frozen shrimp (HBL MFCIM260006 / MBL PSSU260222, container PSSU1961220 40RF) was missing, blocking filing of the import declaration until Blue Harbor Foods supplied it on 2026-02-23.

decisions.summary: Jiwoo Han decided to file the import declaration for HBL MFCIM260006 on 2026-02-23 using the priority slot because free time expires on 2026-02-25.
Jiwoo Han notified Blue Harbor Foods in writing that any charges arising after free time expiry on 2026-02-25 for container PSSU1961220 would be for the consignee's account.

tasks.summary: Bora Jung to send the missing health certificate for HBL MFCIM260006 frozen shrimp shipment.
Dongwook Kim to file the import declaration for HBL MFCIM260006 / MBL PSSU260222 via the priority slot.
Jiwoo Han to arrange the D/O so cleared container PSSU1961220 (40RF) can be released for delivery to Blue Harbor Foods.

deadlines.what: Free time (10 days) expiry for container PSSU1961220 with Pacific Star Shipping.
